messages:
oncall-bot: PagerDuty triggered: INC-3456 — eu-west rollout: canary failures. Paging @alex.w (primary).

alex.w: Got it, looking. Seeing a ~18% increase in 5xx from canary pool (eu-west-1b). Frontend traces show requests routed to old-green endpoints intermittently.

maria.g: I can confirm sticky DNS entries in the edge logs for eu-west-1b returning old-green IPs after the AZ flip. TTLs look fine but clients are hitting cached records.

kyle.h: Runtime logs show model variant mismatch errors on those green endpoints -> KV cache version mismatch 

jamie (eng-runtime): Paging eng-runtime. Likely scenario: partial BGP/edge propagation + feature flag routing (geo-routing-v2) caused split-horizon. Some requests hit new blue (v2) and others hit old-green (v1) with incompatible KV cache. That causes 502/504 cascades.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-3456 — Severity: P1. Channel: #incidents. Runbook: Blue/Green DNS split (link).

alex.w: Immediate mitigation: 1) Kill the routing flag to force stable path 2) Route all traffic to stable green (old) while we investigate, then re-deploy a compatible variant.

maria.g: If we flip flag, we need to do it via LaunchDarkly API so it's atomic. I'll run kill-switch: 
```
# LD API (prod)
curl -X PATCH \"https://app.launchdarkly.com/api/v2/flags/prod/geo-routing-v2\" \\  -H \"Authorization: api-key REDACTED\" \\  -d '{"environments": {"production": {"on": false}}}'
```

kyle.h: Before you flip, can we confirm the health endpoints across AZs? I'm seeing 200 for app-health but 502 at edge-proxy. Quick checks: 
```
curl -sS https://eu-west-1.example.com/_health | jq .
# and
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=ingress -o wide
```

infra-bot: Edge config snapshot attached. Noted that eu-west-1b had a delayed control-plane apply at 23:11 UTC.

alex.w: Maria, proceed with the LD toggle. After toggle, we'll run a staged routing test: 1) curl region endpoint 2) check traces for 200s 3) watch for error regression.

maria.g: Toggling now. 

maria.g: (action) `curl -X PATCH https://app.launchdarkly.com/api/v2/flags/prod/geo-routing-v2 ...` -> response 200, flag set to off. :white_check_mark:

alex.w: Good. Now forcing all traffic to stable pool via edge control: 
```
# force-weights
edgectl set-weight --region eu-west --pool stable-green --weight 100
```

infra-bot: edgectl returned OK. Propagation approx 30s.

kyle.h: Running health probes now. Results: edge -> stable-green 200 for 95% of probes, remaining ~5% come back with 502 from stale cache endpoints (likely clients still using older DNS).

jamie (eng-runtime): Flush KV cache on green endpoints to avoid mismatch: 
```
ssh ops@green-1b 'systemctl restart redwood-runtime && /usr/local/bin/kv-flush --all'
```

maria.g: Restarted runtime on green-1b, KV flush complete.

alex.w: Observability — latency and error rates dropping. 5xx from eu-west canary pool down from 18% -> 1.2% over last 6m.

maria.g: DNS TTL for edge is 60s, but upstream caches had longer TTL. I've requested Cloud DNS support to propagate an aggressive purge; also pushed a small TTL override via edge config.

infra-bot: Cloud DNS purge requested (ticket CD-9876). Estimated completion 10m.

kyle.h: Customer impact check: We saw elevated 5xxs for ~12 minutes. Looking at customer telemetry, affected customers ~0.7% of active sessions (mostly EU-based API keys). No data loss, errors were transient 502/503.

alex.w: Communication: @product-social — please prepare a short note: limited EU region errors for ~15 minutes, mitigated by routing rollback. No data exfiltration.

jamie (eng-runtime): Postmortem action items so far: 
- Add additional preflight for AZ/edge config sync before rollouts
- Add compatibility guard for KV schema versions and model variants
- Extend runbook to include LaunchDarkly atomic rollback snippet

maria.g: For the immediate next steps, I'll schedule a controlled re-roll with a compatible runtime build and a new canary with KV forward-compat checks.

alex.w: Incident status: mitigated -> moving to monitoring. Keeping channel open for 30m. I'll hand off to oncall rotation for post-incident follow-up.

oncall-bot: Handoff: Primary @alex.w -> Secondary @kyle.h. PagerDuty note updated.

kyle.h: Acknowledged, taking rotation. I'll consolidate logs and open RCA ticket in next hour.

maria.g: Link to quick artifacts: traces (link), edge snapshots (link), LD audit (link).

alex.w: Thanks everyone. Final note for timeline and customer impact will be added to INC-3456. :thumbsup:
